definitions.gloss: receipt; receiving; acceptance (of goods, documents, payment)
definitions.explanation: The formal act of receiving goods, documents, or payments, typically in a business or official setting. Much more formal than the everyday word 受け取る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受領|じゅりょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受領|じゅりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A signature is required to receive the package.

examples.japanese: {受領|じゅりょう}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りました→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I sent a receipt confirmation email, so please check it.

notes:
A formal term for the act of receiving goods, documents, or payments. Used primarily in business and official contexts. Much more formal than ⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受領|じゅりょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to receive (formal)
- {受領書|じゅりょうしょ}: receipt (document)
- {受領証|じゅりょうしょう}: certificate of receipt
- {受領|じゅりょう}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: receipt confirmation
- {受領|じゅりょう}{日|び}: date of receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive — the everyday, general word for receiving
- ⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧: acceptance/receipt — specifically for official applications and documents being formally accepted by an authority
- ⟦{領収|りょうしゅう}→領収：08640_ryoushuu⟧: receipt (of payment) — specifically for money; ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧ is the standard word for a payment receipt
